rationale: Use the pale sage character on a supporting surface rather than on text. A nearly white reading field gives the dark green text clear light-dark structure, while one deeper green action creates emphasis without adding a competing hue family. This is a design judgment based on the role and character principles, not a universal guarantee of calmness.
alternative: For a stronger sage identity, swap the background and surface tones while retaining dark text and the same action hue; compare the two in the actual reading layout and recheck all pairs rather than assuming the reversal works.
tradeoff: The related greens are cohesive but restrained; this draft does not yet establish hover, focus, disabled or status colors, dark mode, or a full article's reading comfort. It is a synthetic opaque-sRGB study, not a verified brand palette or complete accessibility audit.
